name: subagent-delegation
description: demo-lead delegates to demo-coder, which IS on its roster, and the delegation must reach the model as a real, non-error tool result -- not a scripted reply that merely describes success. The delegated child is a REAL AgentSession that runs its own turn through the shared ScriptedLLM (there is no session-scoped LLM in this harness), so the child's own step is scripted positionally between the parent's delegate call and the parent's next call -- the parent's delegate tool call blocks polling the SubagentRequest until the child finishes, so the child's Send() is guaranteed to land strictly between those two parent calls. demo-lead then asks to delegate to demo-sre, a class that is neither on the roster nor defined anywhere in the fixture, and that must be denied with the refusal reaching the model as an error naming demo-sre -- not a generic failure and not a success the transcript merely narrates as a refusal. The off-roster denial happens before any child is created, so there is no second child turn to script.
